description: This file defines the GeoZone class in the Opencart e-commerce platform. It provides methods to retrieve geo zone records and related data from the database, encapsulating database queries related to geographical zones.

classes.name: GeoZone
classes.description: A model class for handling geographical zone data within the Opencart platform, providing methods to fetch geo zone details from the database.

methods.name: getGeoZone
methods.description: Retrieves a specific geo zone record based on geo zone ID, country ID, and zone ID.

methods.name: getGeoZones
methods.description: Retrieves all geo zone records ordered by name.
